ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is a black surface-mount inductor, with the white number “151” clearly marked on the top. Reasoning: According to the common three-digit inductor marking rule, the first two digits “15” represent the significant figures, and the third digit “1” represents the exponent multiple of 10 in units of microhenries. Therefore the inductance value is 15 × 10^1 = 150 μH. The problem asks to fill in the numerical value before μH, so 150.0 should be filled in.

planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use the standard 3-digit inductor value code in microhenries: the first two digits are significant figures and the third digit is the power-of-ten multiplier. Thus 151 means 15 × 10^1 μH = 150 μH.
